title: Unsupervised machine learning guides discovery of a lithium solid electrolyte
summary: Unsupervised machine learning of experimentally explored chemistry, combined with crystal structure prediction, selected element combinations for new inorganic solids. The approach predicted a novel quaternary lithium solid electrolyte that was then synthesized, and the group reports four new materials in total. The conductivity values of the synthesized compounds were not verified in this search.
ai_technology: Unsupervised machine learning for element selection with crystal structure prediction

evidence.tested: The predicted Li3.3SnS3.3Cl0.7 phase was synthesized, and conductivity was measured by AC impedance from 25 to 125 C, with 400 hours of lithium plating/stripping.
evidence.unknown: The VAE was trained only on positive examples, the target composition cannot be exactly reached, and the NMR-derived barrier differs from the impedance value.
evidence.ai_role: An unsupervised variational autoencoder trained on ICSD phase fields ranked untested quaternary fields; crystal structure prediction then identified the composition region, and researchers made the final decisions.
